cn_steps: 启用 `Modular Test Runner UI Tests`（模块 `ModularTestRunnerUITests`）。
它是测试 `Modular Tests Runner` 编辑器 UI 的配套插件。
在 CI/自动化里跑这些用例，验证 Runner UI 行为。
这是测试配套插件，不要打进发行版本。
en_steps: Enable `Modular Test Runner UI Tests` (module `ModularTestRunnerUITests`).
It is the companion plugin that tests the `Modular Tests Runner` editor UI.
Run these cases in CI/automation to validate Runner UI behavior.
It is a test companion; do not ship it in release builds.
note_cn: 测试 Modular Tests Runner 编辑器 UI 的配套插件。
note_en: A companion plugin testing the Modular Tests Runner editor UI.

cn_steps: 启用 `Modular Test Screenshot Tests`（模块 `ModularTestScreenshotTests`）。
它是 `ModularTestScreenshot` 的测试伴侣：证明客户端捕获能落盘、且比较结论可使测试失败。
在 CI/自动化里跑这些用例，验证截图比对链路。
这是测试配套插件，不要打进发行版本。
en_steps: Enable `Modular Test Screenshot Tests` (module `ModularTestScreenshotTests`).
It is the test companion for `ModularTestScreenshot`: proves a client capture reaches disk and a comparison verdict can fail a test.
Run these cases in CI/automation to validate the screenshot-compare chain.
It is a test companion; do not ship it in release builds.
note_cn: ModularTestScreenshot 的测试伴侣（验证落盘+比对）。
note_en: The test companion for ModularTestScreenshot (disk + compare).

cn_steps: 启用 `Modular Test Screenshot`（模块 `ModularTestScreenshot`、`ModularTestScreenshotCompare`）。
它是模块化测试框架的可选截图捕获与比较实用程序。
需要捕获或比较客户端视口的测试应依赖它。
属测试可选插件；配合 `Modular Test Framework`。
en_steps: Enable `Modular Test Screenshot` (modules `ModularTestScreenshot`, `ModularTestScreenshotCompare`).
It is the optional screenshot capture and comparison utility for the Modular Test Framework.
Tests that need to capture or compare a client viewport should depend on it.
It is an optional test plugin; used with `Modular Test Framework`.
note_cn: 模块化测试框架的可选截图捕获/比较工具。
note_en: Optional screenshot capture/compare utilities for the Modular Test Framework.

cn_steps: 启用 `Modular Test Unmount Fixture`（模块 `ModularTestUnmountFixture`）。
它是框架自测试用的“惰性夹具”（mount/unmount 会被自测挂载/卸载），本身不含任何测试。
无需手动跑；由框架自测使用。
这是测试夹具，不要当测试套件用。
en_steps: Enable `Modular Test Unmount Fixture` (module `ModularTestUnmountFixture`).
It is an inert fixture the framework self-tests mount and unmount; it contains no tests itself.
No need to run it manually; the framework self-tests use it.
It is a test fixture, not a test suite.
note_cn: 框架自测用的惰性 mount/unmount 夹具（不含测试）。
note_en: An inert mount/unmount fixture for framework self-tests (contains no tests).

cn_steps: 启用 `Modular Viewports`（模块 `ModularViewports`），运行时插件。
它提供比 Game Viewport Client 更灵活、更细粒度的 Viewport Client 实现。
在需要自定义视口布局/多视口/嵌入视口的场景里使用其 Client。
运行时模块可进游戏包；也可与编辑器工具集成。
en_steps: Enable `Modular Viewports` (module `ModularViewports`), a runtime plugin.
It provides Viewport Client implementations with more flexibility and granularity than the Game Viewport Client.
Use its clients where you need custom viewport layout/multi-viewport/embedded viewports.
Runtime modules can ship; it can also integrate with editor tools.
note_cn: 比 Game Viewport Client 更灵活的模块化视口客户端。
note_en: Modular viewport clients more flexible than the Game Viewport Client.

cn_steps: 启用 `ModularTestVerse Tests`（模块 `ModularTestVerseTests`）。
它是 ModularTestVerse 的配套测试插件，用真实 Verse 协程对 `UMTFVerseTaskOps` 做验收测试。
在 CI/自动化里跑这些 Verse 验收用例。
这是测试配套插件，不要打进发行版本。
en_steps: Enable `ModularTestVerse Tests` (module `ModularTestVerseTests`).
It is the companion test plugin for ModularTestVerse, acceptance-testing `UMTFVerseTaskOps` with a real Verse coroutine.
Run these Verse acceptance cases in CI/automation.
It is a test companion; do not ship it in release builds.
note_cn: ModularTestVerse 的 Verse 验收测试配套插件。
note_en: The Verse acceptance-test companion for ModularTestVerse.

cn_steps: 启用 `Motion Design Data Link Integration`（运行时 `AvalancheDataLink`，编辑器 `AvalancheDataLinkEditor`）。
它把 Data Link（数据链接）集成进 Motion Design（Avalanche）场景，用于拉取外部实时数据。
在 Motion Design 里用 Data Link 节点/任务对接 HTTP/JSON/DataTable/WebSocket 等数据源。
Game 模块依赖 `AvalancheDataLink`；`AvalancheDataLinkEditor` 只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `Motion Design Data Link Integration` (runtime `AvalancheDataLink`, editor `AvalancheDataLinkEditor`).
It integrates Data Link into Motion Design (Avalanche) scenes for pulling external real-time data.
In Motion Design, use Data Link nodes/tasks to hook data sources like HTTP/JSON/DataTable/WebSocket.
Game modules depend on `AvalancheDataLink`; `AvalancheDataLinkEditor` is Editor-target only.
note_cn: 把 Data Link 集成进 Motion Design(Avalanche) 的数据对接。
note_en: Integrates Data Link into Motion Design (Avalanche) for data hookups.

cn_steps: 启用 `Motion Design Data Link OAuth`（运行时 `DataLinkOAuth`，编辑器 `DataLinkOAuthEditor`）。
它为 Motion Design Data Link 提供 OAuth 2.0 鉴权能力。
在 Data Link 拉取需要鉴权的数据源时，用它完成 OAuth 2.0 流程。
Game 模块依赖 `DataLinkOAuth`；编辑器模块只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `Motion Design Data Link OAuth` (runtime `DataLinkOAuth`, editor `DataLinkOAuthEditor`).
It adds OAuth 2.0 authentication to Motion Design Data Link.
Use it to run the OAuth 2.0 flow when Data Link pulls from authenticated data sources.
Game modules depend on `DataLinkOAuth`; editor modules go to Editor targets only.
note_cn: Motion Design Data Link 的 OAuth 2.0 鉴权。
note_en: OAuth 2.0 auth for Motion Design Data Link.

cn_steps: 启用 `Motion Design Data Link`（模块 `DataLink`、`DataLinkEdGraph`、`DataLinkHttp`、`DataLinkJson`、`DataLinkDataTable`、`DataLinkWebSocket`，编辑器 `DataLinkEditor` 等）。
它用数据链接图把外部数据源（HTTP/JSON/DataTable/WebSocket）接入 Motion Design。
在数据链接编辑器里搭建图，定义取数/推送逻辑。
Game 模块依赖运行时模块；`*Editor` 模块只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `Motion Design Data Link` (modules `DataLink`, `DataLinkEdGraph`, `DataLinkHttp`, `DataLinkJson`, `DataLinkDataTable`, `DataLinkWebSocket`, editor `DataLinkEditor`, etc.).
It uses data-link graphs to bring external data sources (HTTP/JSON/DataTable/WebSocket) into Motion Design.
Build graphs in the Data Link editor to define fetch/push logic.
Game modules depend on runtime modules; `*Editor` modules go to Editor targets only.
note_cn: Data Link 数据链接图（HTTP/JSON/DataTable/WebSocket 接入）。

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `Motion Design For nDisplay`（模块 `AvalancheDisplayCluster`）。
它把 Motion Design（Avalanche）渲染接到 nDisplay 集群（LED 墙/CAVE/集群视口）。
在虚拟制片里配合 Switchboard、Live Link、摄像机跟踪使用。
Experimental：接口可能变动；需 nDisplay 与 Motion Design 已启用。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Motion Design For nDisplay` (module `AvalancheDisplayCluster`).
It connects Motion Design (Avalanche) rendering to nDisplay clusters (LED walls/CAVE/cluster viewports).
In virtual production, use it with Switchboard, Live Link, and camera tracking.
Experimental: contract may change; requires nDisplay and Motion Design enabled.
note_cn: 把 Motion Design 渲染接到 nDisplay 集群，实验性。
note_en: Connects Motion Design rendering to nDisplay clusters, experimental.

cn_steps: 启用 `Motion Design Scene State Data Link Bridge`（运行时 `SceneStateDataLink`，编辑器 `SceneStateDataLinkEditor`）。
它提供“执行数据链接图”的场景状态任务，把 Data Link 接进 Scene State。
在 Scene State 机里用这些任务触发数据链接图执行。
Game 模块依赖 `SceneStateDataLink`；编辑器模块只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `Motion Design Scene State Data Link Bridge` (runtime `SceneStateDataLink`, editor `SceneStateDataLinkEditor`).
It provides Scene State tasks that execute Data Link graphs, bridging Data Link into Scene State.
In a Scene State machine, use these tasks to trigger data-link graph execution.
Game modules depend on `SceneStateDataLink`; editor modules go to Editor targets only.
note_cn: 执行数据链接图的场景状态任务桥。
note_en: Scene State tasks that execute Data Link graphs.

cn_steps: 启用 `Motion Design Scene State Integration`（模块 `AvalancheSceneState`、`AvalancheSceneStateBlueprint`，编辑器 `AvalancheSceneStateEditor`）。
它把 Scene State 集成进 Motion Design（Avalanche），用状态机驱动 Motion Design 场景。
在 Motion Design 里用 Scene State 蓝图片驱动场景状态切换。
Game 模块依赖运行时模块；`*Editor` 模块只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `Motion Design Scene State Integration` (modules `AvalancheSceneState`, `AvalancheSceneStateBlueprint`, editor `AvalancheSceneStateEditor`).
It integrates Scene State into Motion Design (Avalanche) so a state machine drives Motion Design scenes.
In Motion Design, use Scene State Blueprints to drive scene-state switching.
Game modules depend on runtime modules; `*Editor` modules go to Editor targets only.
note_cn: 把 Scene State 集成进 Motion Design(Avalanche)。
note_en: Integrates Scene State into Motion Design (Avalanche).

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `Motion Design Scene State`（模块 `SceneState`、`SceneStateBinding`、`SceneStateEvent`、`SceneStateTasks`、`SceneStateGameplay`、`SceneStateMachineGraph` 等）。
它是 Scene State 框架本体：用状态机/事件/任务组织场景状态。
搭建 State Machine Graph，绑定事件与任务驱动 Motion Design/玩法状态。
Experimental：接口可能变动；编辑器图模块只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Motion Design Scene State` (modules `SceneState`, `SceneStateBinding`, `SceneStateEvent`, `SceneStateTasks`, `SceneStateGameplay`, `SceneStateMachineGraph`, etc.).
It is the Scene State framework itself: organize scene state with state machines/events/tasks.
Build a State Machine Graph and bind events/tasks to drive Motion Design/gameplay state.
Experimental: contract may change; editor graph modules go to Editor targets only.
note_cn: Scene State 状态机框架本体（事件/任务/图）。

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `Motion Design Sequence Navigator Bridge`（模块 `AvalancheSequenceNavigator`）。
它为嵌入式 Motion Design 序列提供序列导航器桥，方便在序列间跳转。
在编辑 Motion Design 序列时用导航器桥定位片段。
Experimental：接口可能变动；属序列编辑辅助。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Motion Design Sequence Navigator Bridge` (module `AvalancheSequenceNavigator`).
It provides a sequence navigator bridge for embedded Motion Design sequences to jump between them.
Use the navigator bridge while editing Motion Design sequences to locate segments.
Experimental: contract may change; it is sequence-editing assist.
note_cn: 嵌入式 Motion Design 序列的导航器桥，实验性。
note_en: A sequence navigator bridge for embedded Motion Design sequences, experimental.

cn_steps: 启用 `Motion Design`（模块 `Avalanche`、`AvalancheCore`、`AvalancheCamera`、`AvalancheEffectors`、`AvalancheEditor` 等，含 Editor 版），属 Virtual Production。
它是合成、设计与广播工具（Motion Design/Avalanche），做动态图形与实时播出。
用它搭建动态图形场景、效果器与镜头，配合其依赖（Dynamic Material、Geometry Scripting、Media IO、Text3D 等）出片。
Game 模块依赖运行时模块；`*Editor` 模块只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `Motion Design` (modules `Avalanche`, `AvalancheCore`, `AvalancheCamera`, `AvalancheEffectors`, `AvalancheEditor`, etc., with Editor variants), part of Virtual Production.
It is the compositing, design, and broadcasting tool (Motion Design/Avalanche) for motion graphics and live output.
Use it to build motion-graphics scenes, effectors, and cameras, leveraging its dependencies (Dynamic Material, Geometry Scripting, Media IO, Text3D, etc.).
Game modules depend on runtime modules; `*Editor` modules go to Editor targets only.
note_cn: 合成/设计/广播工具 Motion Design(Avalanche)，动态图形与实时播出。
note_en: The Motion Design (Avalanche) compositing/design/broadcast tool for motion graphics and live output.
